full_name: Brodwyn Fischer | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2022–2023 History Frieda L. Miller Fellow The University of Chicago
bio: Brodwyn Fischer is a historian of inequality and its persistence who specializes in the study of Brazil and Latin America, focusing particularly on informality, cities, citizenship, law, migration, race, and slavery and its afterlives.
